entities.description: A young Black male with short, dark, textured hair is shown in profile facing left, wearing a black Adidas track jacket with white stripes on the sleeves. He is holding a pink and white soccer ball with both hands, and the background features a blurred green lawn and trees.

entities.description: An older Black man with a grey beard and mustache stands outdoors wearing a dark grey knit beanie and a vibrant blue short-sleeved Hawaiian shirt featuring a tropical print of palm trees, pink hibiscus flowers, and the word 'Caribbean'.
